title: Characterization of Autoproliferating B and T Cells in Multiple Sclerosis
author: Qiu, Marti, et al.
materials: LIVE/DEAD Fixable Aqua Dead Cell Stain Kit

steps.title: Prepare and thaw PBMCs
steps.instruction: Pre‑warm complete IMDM medium to 37 °C and transfer 20–30 mL into a 50 mL Falcon tube. Thaw cryopreserved PBMCs by swirling the vial in a 37 °C water bath until almost fully thawed, then immediately transfer the cells into the pre‑warmed IMDM. Aim to start with ≥10⁸ PBMCs (expect ~50 % loss on freeze‑thaw and ~25 % loss during CFSE labeling). Centrifuge at 400 g for 5 min at 22 °C, discard supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 20 mL wash solution. If clumping occurs, repeat centrifugation and resuspend in serum‑free AIM‑V containing 50 U/mL DNase I; incubate 37 °C for 15 min. Centrifuge again at 400 g for 5 min at 22 °C, discard supernatant and resuspend in 5 mL wash solution. Count cells and adjust the concentration to up to 10⁷ cells/mL; keep the suspension in a 50 mL tube.

steps.title: CFSE staining of cells
steps.instruction: Turn off the light in the laminar flow hood. Reconstitute CellTrace CFSE by adding 18 µL DMSO to one vial of dye to obtain a 5 mM stock (protect from light). Prepare a 1 µM working solution by adding 2 µL of the 5 mM stock to 10 mL sterile PBS in a 15 mL Falcon tube. Add the CFSE working solution to the PBMC suspension 1:1 (e.g., 10 mL cells + 10 mL CFSE) and incubate exactly 3 min, gently swirling every ~30 s. Stop labeling by diluting the cells 1:5 in cold quenching medium (e.g., add 10 mL quench to 2 mL labeled cells). Centrifuge at 400 g for 10 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 20 mL serum‑free AIM‑V medium. Centrifuge again at 400 g for 5 min at 22 °C.

steps.title: Seed cells for autoproliferation culture
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant and resuspend the cells in 5 mL AIM‑V medium. Count cells and adjust the CFSE‑labeled cell concentration to 1 × 10⁶ cells/mL. Seed 200 µL (2 × 10⁵ cells) per well in 96‑well U‑bottom plates (minimum 10 replicate wells per sample). Use Greiner U‑bottom plates; do not use flat‑ or V‑bottom plates. Avoid seeding cells in the outer rim; instead fill outer wells with 200 µL sterile PBS to minimize evaporation. Incubate the plates for 7 days at 37 °C in a humidified incubator with 5 % CO₂, loosely covering with aluminum foil to protect from light while allowing air exchange. Do not disturb or shake the plates during incubation.

steps.title: Stain and prepare cells for flow cytometry
steps.instruction: On day 7, work under sterile conditions and protect cells from light. Transfer plates to the biosafety cabinet. Carefully collect 100 µL supernatant from each well into a new plate for optional cytokine analysis (avoid disturbing the cell pellet). Resuspend the remaining cells, pool replicates into a sterile FACS tube, and centrifuge at 400 g for 5 min at 4 °C. Discard supernatant, resuspend the pellet in 1 mL PBS, and centrifuge again at 400 g for 5 min at 4 °C. Prepare an FcR‑blocking/live‑dead mix (PBS + 1:100 live/dead dye + 1:20 FcR‑blocking reagent); allocate 100 µL per sample plus 10 % excess. Discard supernatant and resuspend each sample in 100 µL of this mix; incubate 30 min at 4 °C. Wash cells with 2 mL ice‑cold FACS buffer and centrifuge at 400 g for 5 min at 4 °C. Prepare antibody staining mix by diluting each antibody 1:100 in FACS buffer (100 µL per 10 replicate wells, plus 10 % excess). Add 100 µL antibody mix to each sample, vortex briefly, and incubate 30 min at 4 °C. Wash with 2 mL cold FACS buffer, centrifuge at 400 g for 5 min at 4 °C, then resuspend in 500 µL cold FACS buffer and keep on ice. Acquire data on a conventional or spectral flow cytometer; CFSE‑dim B and T cell populations (proliferated cells) can be sorted for downstream analyses.
